mapper.select: select f.* from sys_hospital_favorite f inner join sys_hospital_post p on p.post_id=f.post_id where f.author_account=#{account} order by f.favorite_id desc
select * from sys_hospital_favorite where user_id=#{userId} and post_id=#{postId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_hospital_favorite(user_id,author_account,post_id,created_at,original_author_id,original_author_account,crop,planting_time,description) select #{userId},#{authorAccount},p.post_id,#{createdAt},#{originalAuthorId},#{originalAuthorAccount},#{crop},#{plantingTime},#{description} from sys_hospital_post p where p.post_id=#{postId}
